text: Big Bottles
Big Bottles (BB) produce plastic bottles for the soft drinks industry. BB has a number of
difficulties.
Extract of statement from Chairman of Big Bottles
We need to change. Bottles from cheaper imported sources have increased
competition and reduced our sales. Soft drink producers are expecting higher
quality at lower prices. For example, Fruity Surprises, our biggest customer,
plans to reduce its purchases of our plastic bottles. The following financial
information highlights the problems:

increasing problem. We must look at ways of turning the business around or
we will not survive.
Extract of statement from Chairman of Fruity Surprises
We aim to cut expenditure on plastic bottles and containers by 30% next year. 20

that this is what our customers expect. Our competitors are using much more
attractive bottles and labels for their drinks.
Extract from statement by the Government
This is a difficult time with the country’s economy still in recession. We plan
to stimulate economic growth. We are considering both fiscal and monetary
policies. We want to avoid devaluing our currency.

text: Newtown University
Newtown University (NU) is in the tertiary sector. NU has a very high reputation for
research into electronics technology. NU is expecting a smaller grant from the Government
next year even though its costs are rising.
The University management is discussing a scheme to provide extra revenue by using its
staff and facilities to do research into possible new products. Businesses will pay NU for 5
the results of the research.
Extra laboratories and equipment will have to be provided. Facilities will have to
be managed better to improve operational efficiency. Businesses will expect NU’s
researchers to develop new materials and ideas for new products.
